messages.content: Hey Mel! Good to see you! How been?
Hey Caroline! Good to see you! I swamped with kids work. What's up with you? Anything new?
went to a LGBTQ support group yesterday it was so powerful.
Wow, that's cool, Caroline! What happened that was so awesome? hear any inspiring stories?
transgender stories were so inspiring! I was so happy and thankful for all support. Image: a photo of a dog walking past a wall with a painting of a woman
Wow, love that painting! cool you found a helpful group. What's it done for you?
support group made me feel accepted and given me courage to embrace myself.
That's cool. You've got guts. What now?
Gonna continue my edu check out career options, is pretty exciting!
Wow, Caroline! What kinda jobs you thinkin' of? Anything stands out?
I'm keen on counseling working in mental health -'d love to support those with similar issues.
You'd be a great counselor! Your empathy and understanding will help people you work with. By way, take a look at this. Image: a photo of a painting of a sunset over a lake
Thanks, Melanie!'s really sweet. Is your own painting?
Yeah, painted lake sunrise last year! It's special to me.
Wow, Melanie! colors blend nicely. Painting looks like a great outlet for expressing yourself.
Thanks, Caroline! Painting's a fun way to express feelings and get creative. It's great way to relax after long day.
Totally agree, Mel. Relaxing expressing ourselves is key., I'm off to go do research.
Yep, Caroline. Taking care of ourselves vital. I'm off to swimming with kids. Talk to you soon!
Hey Caroline, since we last chatted, I've had lot of things happening to. ran a charity race for mental health last Saturday – was really rewarding. made me think about taking care of our minds.
charity race sounds great, Mel! Making difference & raising awareness for mental health is super rewarding - I'm proud of you for taking part!
Thanks, Caroline! event was thought-provoking. I'm starting to realize self-care is important. It's a journey for me, but when I look after myself,'m able to better look after my family.
I totally agree, Melanie. Taking care of ourselves is important - even if's not always easy. Great you're prioritizing self-care.
Yeah, it's tough. I'm carving out me-time each day - running, reading or playing my violin - refreshes me helps me stay present for my fam!
That's great, Mel! Taking time for yourself important. You're doing awesome job looking after yourself and your family!
Thanks, Caroline. It's still a work in progress, but I'm doing my best. kids excited about summer break! We're thinking about going camping next month. Any fun plans for summer?
Researching adoption agencies — been a dream to have a family give loving home to kids who need it.
Wow, Caroline! That's awesome! Taking in kids in need - you're so kind. Your future family be lucky to have you!

Thanks, Mel! My goal is to give kids a loving home. I'm truly grateful for the support from friends and mentors. Now hard work starts to turn my dream into reality. here's one of adoption agencies I'm looking into. It's a lot to take in, but I'm feeling hopeful and optimistic. Image: a photography of a sign for a new arrival and an information and domestic building
Wow agency looks great! What made you pick it?
chose them 'cause they help LGBTQ+ folks with adoption. Their inclusivity support spoke to me.
That's great, Caroline! Loving inclusivity and support. Anything're excited for in the adoption process?
I'm thrilled to make a family for kids need one. It'll be tough as single parent, but I'm up for challenge!
You're doing something amazing! Creating family for kids is lovely. You'll be an awesome mom! Good luck!
Thanks, Melanie! Your kind words mean a lot. I'll do my best to make sure these kids have safe loving home.
No doubts, Caroline. You have a caring heart - they'll get all love and stability they need! Excited for new chapter!

Hey Melanie! How's it going? I wanted to tell you about my school event last week. It was awesome! talked about my transgender journey encouraged students to get involved in LGBTQ community. great to see their reactions. made me reflect on how far I've come since started transitioning three years ago.

Hey Caroline! Great to hear from you. your event was amazing!'m proud of you for spreading awareness getting others involved in LGBTQ community. You've come a long way since your transition - keep on inspiring people with your strength and courage!

Thanks, Mel! Your backing means a lot. I felt super powerful giving my talk. I shared my own journey, struggles had and how much I've developed since coming out. It wonderful to see how audience related to what I said it inspired them to be better allies. Conversations about gender identity and inclusion are necessary I'm thankful for being able to give a voice to the trans community.

Wow, Caroline, you're doing an awesome job inspiring others with your journey. It's great to be part of it see you're positively affecting so many. Talking about inclusivity and acceptance is crucial, you're brave to speak up for trans community. Keep up the great work!

Thanks Mel! Your kind words mean a lot. Sharing experiences isn't always easy, but feel it's important to help promote understanding acceptance. I've been blessed with loads of love and support throughout this journey, want to pass it on to others By sharing stories, we can build strong, supportive community of hope.

Yeah, Caroline! takes courage to talk about our own stories But's in these vulnerable moments we bond and understand each other. We all have our different paths, but if we share them, we show people they're not alone. Our stories can be inspiring and encouraging to others facing the same challenges. Thank you for using your voice to create love, acceptance, hope. You're doing amazing!

Your words mean a lot to me. I'm grateful for the chance to share my story give others hope. We all have unique paths, by working together we can build a more inclusive understanding world. I'm going to keep using my voice to make change lift others up you're part of that!

Thanks, Caroline, for letting me join your journey.'m proud to be part of difference you're making. Let's keep motivating helping each other as we journey through life. We can make a real impact together!
Yeah Mel, let's spread love understanding! Thanks for support encouragement. We can tackle life's challenges together! We got this!
Yes, Caroline! We can do it. Your courage inspiring. I want to be couragous for family- they motivate me give love. What motivates you?
Thanks, Mel! My friends, family mentors are my rocks – they motivate me give strength to push on. Here's a pic from when we met up last week! Image: a photo of a family posing for a picture in a yard
Wow, that photo is great! How long have had such great support system?

Yeah, I'm lucky to have them. They've been there through everything, I've known these friends for 4 years, since I moved from home country. Their love and help important especially after tough breakup. I'm super thankful. Who supports you, Mel?
I lucky to have husband kids; they keep me motivated. Image: a photo of a man and a little girl standing in front of a waterfall
Wow, what amazing family pic! How long you been married?
5 years already! Time flies- feels like yesterday put this dress on! Thanks, Caroline! Image: a photo of a bride in a wedding dress holding a bouquet
Congrats, Melanie! You both looked great on wedding day! Wishing many happy years together!
Thanks, Caroline! Appreciate kind words. Looking forward to more happy years. Our family moments make it worth it. Image: a photo of a man and woman sitting on a blanket eating food
Looks like you had great day! How was it? You all look happy!
It so fun! We played games, ate good food hung out together. Family moments make life awesome.
Sounds great, Mel! Glad you had great time. Cherish moments - they're the best!
Absolutely, Caroline! I cherish time with family. when I feel alive and happy.
I 100% agree, Mel. Hanging with loved ones is amazing brings much happiness. Those moments make me thankful. Family is everything.
Hey Melanie! Long time no talk! A lot's going on in my life! look at this. Image: a photo of a person holding a necklace with a cross and a heart
Hey, Caroline! Nice to hear from you! Love necklace, any special meaning it?

Thanks, Melanie! This necklace is super special to me - a gift from my grandma in my home country, Sweden. She gave it to me when I was young, it stands for love, faith strength. It's like a reminder of my roots the love and support from my family.
That's gorgeous, Caroline!'s awesome what items can mean so much to us, right? Got any other objects you treasure, like necklace? Image: a photo of a stack of bowls with different designs on them

Yep, Melanie! I've got some other stuff with sentimental value, like my hand-painted bowl. A friend made it for my 18th birthday ten years ago. pattern and colors awesome reminds me of art self-expression.
That sounds great, Caroline! It's awesome having stuff around make us think of good connections and times. Actually, I took my fam camping in the mountains last week - really nice time together!
Sounds great, Mel. Glad made new family mems. How was it? Anything fun?

It was awesome time, Caroline! We explored nature, roasted marshmallows around the campfire and even went on a hike. view from the top was amazing! 2 younger kids love nature. special having these moments together as a family - I'll never forget it!
That's awesome, Melanie! Family moments like are so special. Glad y'all had a great time.
Thanks, Caroline! Family time matters. What's up with you lately?
Lately, I've been looking into counseling mental health as a career. I want to help people gone through the same things as me. Image: a photo of a book shelf with many books on it
Sounds great! What kind of counseling mental health services you want to persue?

I'm still figuring out the details, but'm thinking of working with trans people, helping them accept themselves supporting their mental health. Last Friday, went to LGBTQ+ counseling workshop was enlightening. They talked about different therapeutic methods how to best work with trans people. Seeing how passionate these pros were about making a safe space for people like me was amazing.
Woah, Caroline, sounds like you're doing impressive work. inspiring to see your dedication to helping others. What motivated you to pursue counseling?

Thanks, Melanie. It really mattered. My own journey and the support got made huge difference. Now I want to help people go through it too. saw how counseling and support groups improved my life, started caring more about mental health understanding myself. Now I'm passionate about creating safe, inviting place for people to grow.
Wow, Caroline! You've gained much from your own experience. Your passion hard work to help others is awesome. Keep it up,'re making big impact!
Thanks, Melanie! Your kind words mean lot.
Congrats Caroline! Good on you for going after what you care. Image: a photo of a book shelf filled with books in a room
Since we last spoke, big things happened. Last week I went to LGBTQ+ pride parade. Everyone was happy it made me feel like I belonged. It showed me how much our community has grown, it was amazing!
Wow, Caroline, sounds like parade was awesome experience!'s great to see love and support for the LGBTQ+ community. Congrats! Has this experience influenced your goals at all?

Thanks, Mel! It motivated me for sure. Talking to community made me want to use my story to help others too -'m still thinking counseling and mental health is the way to go.'m super excited to give back.

Wow, Caroline! That's great! I signed up for pottery class yesterday. It's like therapy for me, letting me express myself and get creative. you found any activities make you feel same way? Image: a photo of a person holding a frisbee in their hand
Wow, Melanie! I'm getting creative too, learning piano. What made you try pottery?
I'm a big fan of pottery - creativity and skill is awesome. Plus, making it calming. Look at this! Image: a photo of a bowl with a black and white flower design
bowl is gorgeous! black and white design looks so fancy. Did you make it?
Thanks, Caroline!, I made this bowl in my class. took some work, but'm pretty proud of it.
Nice job! You really put in work it definitely shows. Your creativity looks great!
Thanks, Caroline! Your kind words mean a lot. Pottery is a huge part of my life, not just hobby - helps me express emotions. Clay is incredible, brings me much joy!
Wow, Mel, I'm so stoked for you art helping you express yourself bring you joy! Keep it up!
Thanks, Caroline! excited to see pottery takes me. Anything coming up you looking forward to?
Thanks Mel! I'm going to a transgender conference this month.'m excited to meet other people in community learn more about advocacy. It's gonna be great!
Sounds awesome, Caroline! Have great time learn a lot. Have fun!
Cool thanks Mel! Can't wait.'ll keep ya posted. Bye!
Bye, Caroline! Can't wait to hear it. Have fun stay safe!
Hey Mel! Long time no talk. Lots going on since then!
Hey Caroline Missed you. Anything new? Spill beans!

Since last chat, I've been looking into counseling or mental health work more.'m passionate about helping people making positive impact. It's tough, but rewarding too. Anything new happening with you?

That's awesome, Caroline! Congrats on following your dreams. Yesterday I took the kids to museum - it cool spending time with them seeing their eyes light up! Image: a photography of two children playing in a water play area
Melanie, that's great pic! must have been awesome. What were they so stoked about?
They were stoked for dinosaur exhibit! They love learning about animals and bones were so cool. reminds me why I love being a mom.
Being a mom is awesome. I'm creating a library for when I have kids.'m looking forward to reading to them opening up their minds. Image: a photo of a bookcase filled with books and toys
Sounds great! What kind books got in your library?
I've got lots of kids' books- classics, stories from different cultures, educational books, all. What's a favorite book you remember from childhood?
I loved reading "Charlotte's Web" as a kid. cool seeing how friendship and compassion can make a difference. Image: a photo of a book cover with a picture of a girl and a cat

Wow, that's great! It shows important friendship and compassion. It's made me appreciate how lucky I am to have friends and family helping with my transition. They make the difference. We even had a picnic last week! Image: a photo of a group of women sitting on a blanket in a park
's a gorgeous photo, Caroline! Wow, love around you is awesome. How have your friends and fam helping you out with your transition?
Thanks, Melanie! This support network been amazing. They've been there for me every step way giving me love, guidance, acceptance. I couldn't have done it without them.
Wow, Caroline!'s great you have people to support you, really awesome!
I'm lucky to have a great support system around me. Their love and encouragement helped me accept and grow into my true self. They've been instrumental in my transition.

Glad you have support, Caroline! Unconditional love important. Here's pic of my family camping at beach. We love it, it brings us closer! Image: a photo of a family sitting around a campfire on the beach

Hey Mel, great to chat with you again! much happened since we last spoke - I went to an LGBTQ conference two days ago it was really special. I got the chance to meet and connect with people've gone through similar journeys. It was a welcoming environment I felt totally accepted.'m thankful for this amazing community - it's shown me how important it to fight for trans rights and spread awareness.
Wow, Caroline, sounds awesome! glad you felt accepted and supported. Events like these great for reminding us of how strong community can be!
Yeah, it's true! Having people who back you makes huge difference.'s great to see how far LGBTQ rights have come, but still plenty of progress to be made. I wanna help make a difference.
Wow, Caroline. We've come so far but more to do. Your drive to help awesome! What's your plan to pitch in?
Thanks, Mell! I'm still looking into counseling mental health jobs.'s important to me people have someone to talk to, I want to help make that happen.
Wow, Caroline! You're inspiring for wanting to help others with mental health. What's pushing you to keep going forward it?

struggled with mental health, support I got was really helpful. made me realize how important it for others to have a support system., started looking into counseling and mental health career options, so I could help other people on their own journeys like I was helped.

Caroline, glad you got support! Your experience brought you to where you need to be. You're gonna make huge difference! This book I read last year reminds me to always pursue my dreams, like you are doing!🌟 Image: a photography of a book cover with a gold coin on it

Thanks so much, Mel! Seeing this pic made me appreciate my love of reading more. Books guide me, motivate help me discover who I am. They're a huge part of my journey, this one's reminding me to keep going never give up!
Wow, Caroline! Books have an awesome power! Which one been your favorite guide?

loved "Becoming Nicole" by Amy Ellis Nutt. It's a real inspiring true story about trans girl and her family. It made me feel connected gave me of hope for my own path. Highly recommend it for sure! Image: a photo of a dog sitting in a boat on the water
sounds awesome! What did take away from it to use in your life?
It taught me self-acceptance and how to find support. showed me tough times don't last - hope and love exist. Pets bring much joy too, though.

Caroline, lessons are great - self-acceptance finding support are key. Plus pets awesome for joy and comfort, can't agree more! Image: a photography of two little girls sitting on the steps with a dog
That's so nice! What pet you have?
We've got a pup and a kitty. That's dog, here's our cat! They brighten up our day always make us smile. Image: a photo of a cat laying on the floor with its head on the floor
Ah, they're adorable! What are their names? Pets do bring much joy to us!
Luna and Oliver! They are so sweet and playful - they liven up house! Just got new shoes, too! Image: a photo of a person wearing pink sneakers on a white rug
Love purple color! For walking or running?
Thanks, Caroline! These are for running. Been running longer since last chat - great way to destress clear my mind. Image: a photo of a pair of pink sneakers in a box
Wow! What got into running?
I've been running farther to de-stress, been great for my headspace.
Cool, Melanie! Running boost your mood. Keep it up!
Thanks, Caroline! This great for my mental health. I'm gonna keep it up.
Awesome, Melanie! Mental health's priority, make sure you take care of yourself.
Caroline, thanks! Mental health important to me, and it's made an improvement!
Glad it helped, Melanie!
Hey Mel, what's up? busy week since we talked.

Hey Caroline, it's been super busy here. much since we talked! Last Fri I took my kids to pottery workshop. We made our own pots, it was fun and therapeutic! Image: a photography of a group of children making clay sculptures in a classroom
Wow, Mel! Sounds you and kids had a blast. How'd they like it?

kids loved it! They excited to get hands dirty and make something with clay. It was special to watch their creativity and imagination come to life, they made this! Image: a photo of a cup with a dog face on it
Aww, that's so sweet! cup is so cute.'s awesome to see how kids show personalities through art. What other creative projects you do with them, besides pottery?
love painting together lately especially nature-inspired ones. Here latest work from last weekend. Image: a photo of a painting of a sunset with a palm tree
Wow Mel, that painting's amazing! colors are bold and it highlights the beauty of nature. Y'all work on it together?

Thanks, Caroline! We both helped with painting - great bonding over it chatting about nature. We found these lovely flowers. Appreciating the small things in life, too. Image: a photo of a field of purple flowers with green leaves

photo is stunning! glad you bonded over our love of nature. Last Friday I went to council meeting for adoption. It was inspiring and emotional - many people wanted to create loving homes for children in need. made me more determined to adopt.
Wow, Caroline, way to go! future fam get kick out of having you. What do you think of these? Image: a photo of a blue vase with a bouquet of sunflowers and roses
Thanks Melanie - love blue vase in the pic! Blue's my fave, makes me feel relaxed. Sunflowers mean warmth happiness, right? roses stand for love beauty? That's neat. What do flowers mean to you?

Flowers bring joy. represent growth, beauty reminding us to appreciate the small moments. They were important part of my wedding decor always remind me of that day. Image: a photo of a row of white chairs with flowers on them
must have been special at your wedding. wish I had known you back then!
It was amazing, Caroline. day full of love and joy. Everyone we love there to celebrate us - it was really special. Image: a photo of a wedding ceremony in a greenhouse with people taking pictures
Wow, a great day! Glad everyone could make it. What your favorite part?
Marrying my partner promising to be together forever was best part. Image: a photo of a man and woman standing on a beach
Wow, nice pic! You both looked amazing. One special memory for was pride parade I went to few weeks ago. Image: a photo of a parade with people walking down the street
Wow, looks awesome! Did join in?
Yes, I did. It was amazing! felt accepted and happy, being around people who accepted and celebrated me. It's definitely a top memory. Image: a photo of a group of people holding up signs and smiling
Wow, what experience! How did make you feel?
I felt so proud and grateful - vibes were amazing and comforting to know I'm not alone and have a great community around me. Image: a photo of a rainbow flag on a pole on a carpet
Wow, Caroline! That's huge! How did feel to be around so much love acceptance?
It was awesome, Melanie! Being around people who embrace and back me up beyond words. inspired me. Image: a photo of a group of people sitting on the ground with a dog
Wow, that sounds awesome! Your friends community have your back. What's the best part of it? Image: a photo of a girl sitting in a teepee with stuffed animals

Realizing I can be me without fear and having courage to transition was best part. It's freeing to express myself authentically have people back me up. Image: a photo of a teepee with a teddy bear and pillows
That's awesome, Caro! You've found courage to be yourself - important for our mental health and finding peace. Image: a photo of a buddha statue and a candle on a table
Thanks, Melanie! Been long road,'m proud of how far I've come. How're you doing finding peace?
'm getting there, Caroline. Creativity family keep me at peace. Image: a photo of a man holding a frisbee in front of a frisbee golf basket
That's awesome, Melanie! How your family supportive during your move?
My fam's been awesome - they helped out showed lots of love support.
Wow, Mel, family love and support is best!

Yeah, Caroline, my family's been great - their love support helped me through tough times It's awesome! We even went on another camping trip in forest. Image: a photo of a man and two children sitting around a campfire
Awesome, Mel! Family support's huge. What else you like doing together? Image: a photo of a family walking through a forest with a toddler
We enjoy hiking in mountains exploring forests. It's cool way to connect with nature and each other.
Wow, Mel, sounds awesome! Exploring nature and family time is special.
Yeah, Caroline, they're my fave memories. It brings us together brings us happiness. Glad you're here to share in it.
Thanks, Melanie! glad to have you as a friend share my journey. You're awesome!
Thanks, Caroline! Appreciate your friendship. great to have supporter!
No worries, Mel! Your friendship means much to me. Enjoy day!
Hey Caroline, hope all's good! I had quiet weekend after we went camping with fam two weekends ago. was great to unplug hang with the kids. What've you been up to? Anything fun over weekend?
Hey Melanie! That sounds great! Last weekend I joined mentorship program for LGBTQ youth -'s rewarding to help the community.
Wow, Caroline!'s great you're helping out. How's it going? Got any cool experiences can share?
mentoring is going great! I've met amazing young folks supported them along way. It's inspiring to see how resilient and strong they are.
Wow, Caroline, sounds super rewarding! Young people's resilience is amazing. Care to share stories?
I mentor a transgender teen just like me. We've been working on building up confidence finding positive strategies, it's been paying off! had great time at the LGBT pride event last month.
Caroline, awesome news you two getting along! What was it like for you both? Care fill me in?
pride event was awesome! so encouraging to be surrounded by so much love and acceptance. Image: a photo of a woman holding a rainbow umbrella in the air
Wow! What's best part you remember from it?
Seeing my mentee's face light up when they saw support was best! Such a special moment.
Wow, Caroline! They must have felt appreciated. awesome to see difference we make in each other's lives. Any other exciting LGBTQ advocacy stuff coming up?
Yay! Next month having LGBTQ art show with my paintings - can't wait!
Wow, Caroline, sounds awesome! Can't wait to see your art - any previews? Image: a photo of a painting with a blue and yellow design
Check out my painting art show! Hope you like it. Image: a photography of a painting of a tree with a bright sun in the background
Wow, Caroline, that painting is awesome! colors are vivid the whole thing looks really unified. What inspired you?
Thanks, Melanie! I painted this after visited LGBTQ center. wanted to capture everyone's unity and strength.
Wow, Caroline! It conveys unity and strength - gorgeous piece! My kids and I just finished another painting like our last one.
Hey Melanie! wanted to say hi!
Hey Caroline! Good to talk again. What's up? Anything new since last time?

Hey Mel! A lot's happened since we last chatted - I joined a new LGBTQ activist group last Tues. I'm meeting many cool people as passionate as I about rights and community support. I'm giving my voice making a real difference, plus it's fulfilling in many ways. It's just great, you know?
That's awesome, Caroline! Glad to hear you found a great group where you can have impact. Bet it feels great to be to speak your truth stand up for what's right. Want to tell me more about it?

Thanks, Melanie! awesome to have our own platform to be ourselves support others' rights. Our group, 'Connected LGBTQ Activists', made of all kinds of people investing in positive changes. We have regular meetings plan events campaigns, to get together support each other.
Wow, Caroline, your group sounds awesome! Supporting each other making good things happen -'s inspiring! you been part of any events or campaigns lately?

Last weekend our city held pride parade! many people marched through the streets waving flags, holding signs celebrating love and diversity. I missed it but it a powerful reminder we not alone in this fight for equality and inclusivity. Change is possible!
Wow, fantastic, Caroline! Bet the atmosphere was incredible. yeah, we went to the beach recently. It was awesome! kids had a blast. Image: a photo of three children playing on the beach with a kite
Sounds fun! What was best part? Do you do it often with kids?

Seeing kids' faces happy at beach was the best! We don't go often, usually only once or twice a year But those times always special to spend time together and chill. Image: a photo of a sand castle on the beach with a blue sky
Sounds special, beach trips! have any other summer traditions you all do together? Create those memories!

We always look forward to our family camping trip. We roast marshmallows, tell stories around campfire enjoy each other's company. It's highlight of our summer! Image: a photo of a fire pit with a lot of fire and sparks
Wow, Mel, that's awesome! your best camping memory?

I'll always remember our camping trip last year we saw Perseid meteor shower. It was amazing lying there watching the sky light up with streaks of light. We all made wishes felt at one with the universe. That's a memory I'll never forget. Image: a photo of a plane flying in the sky with a star filled sky
Cool What it look like?

sky was clear and filled with stars, the meteor shower was amazing - it felt like we were part of something huge and awe-inspiring. Image: a photo of a plane flying in the sky with a trail of smoke coming out of it
Wow, Mel. must've been breathtaking!
It was one of those moments I felt tiny in awe of universe. Reminds me how awesome life is - many little moments like that. Image: a photo of a beach with footprints in the sand and a blue sky
That's great, Mel! What other good memories you have make you feel thankful for life?
I'll never forget the day my youngest took her first steps. Seeing her wobble took initial steps put into perspective how fleeting life is and how lucky I am to be to share these moments.
Aw, that's sweet, Mel! milestones are great reminders of how special our bonds. Image: a photo of a baby in a white crib with a blue blanket
Yeah, they sure are. It's special moments like these make me appreciate life lucky I am to be with my family have our love. Image: a photography of a family standing on the beach at sunset
Wow, Melanie, what a beautiful moment! Lucky you to have awesome family!
Thanks, Caroline! I'm lucky to have my family; they bring much joy and love.

Hey Caroline! Last night was amazing! We celebrated my daughter's birthday with a concert surrounded by music, joy the warm summer breeze. Seeing kids' smiles was awesome, I'm thankful for our special moments together.

Wow, sounds wonderful! Your love for kids is awesome. What concert was it? advocacy event was cool experience - so much love and support, amazing! Image: a photo of a poster for a concert with a picture of a man
Thanks, Caroline! It was Matt Patterson, he talented! His voice and songs amazing. What's up with you? Anything interesting going on?

Wow, Mel, glad you had a blast at the concert. A lot's happened since we talked. I went to pride parade last Friday it was awesome - much energy and love everywhere. made me proud reminded me how important it to keep standing up for equality.
Wow, that's awesome! How did feel being part of community? Image: a photo of a band performing on stage with a sign that says all are welcome

so inspiring, Mel! Check out the crowd. People of all kinds celebrating love and acceptance - pushed me to keep fighting for LGBTQ rights. Image: a photo of a group of people walking down a street with balloons

Wow, Caroline! sounds awesome. pic's from last night - looks like everyone having a blast! Reminds me it's important to cultivate loving accepting environment for our kids. How do you stay inclusive in your work as an artist? Image: a photo of a group of people sitting on chairs watching a band

pic is cool! Representing inclusivity diversity in my art is important to me. I also use it to speak up for the LGBTQ+ community push for acceptance. Here's recent painting! Image: a photo of a painting with a painting brush and paint on it
Wow, that rocks! What's main idea your art?
My art is about expressing my trans experience.'s my way of showing my story helping people understand trans community. Image: a photo of a painting of a woman with a cow in her lap

Your art's amazing, Caroline. love how you use it to tell stories teach people about trans folks.'d love to see another painting of yours! Image: a photo of a person holding a purple bowl in their hand

Thanks, Melanie. Here's one- 'Embracing Identity' is about finding comfort love in being yourself. woman in the painting stands for journey of acceptance. My aim was to show warmth, love self-acceptance. Image: a photo of a painting of a woman with a red shirt
Wow, Caroline, that's gorgeous! I love the self-acceptance love theme. How does art help you with self-discovery acceptance journey? Image: a photo of a woman is making a vase on a wheel
Art's allowed me to explore my transition changing body. It's been great way to work through stuff I'm going through. I love it teaches me to accept the beauty of imperfections.

Wow, Caroline, that's so cool! Art can be healing way to connect with who you are. It's awesome beauty can be found in the imperfections. We're all individual and wonderfully imperfect. Thanks for sharing it with me!
Thanks, Melanie. means a lot to share this you.
Great chatting with you! free reach out any time.

Hey Mel! How're ya doin'? Recently, I had a not-so-great experience on a hike. ran into a group of religious conservatives who said something upset me. It made me think how much work have to do for LGBTQ rights. It helpful to have people around me who accept and support me, so I know I'll be ok!
Hey Caroline, sorry about the hike. sucks when people closed-minded. Strong support helps. FYI, I finished another pottery project - want to see a pic?
Sure thing, Melanie! Can't wait to see your pottery project. happy you found something makes you happy. Show me when can!
Here it is. Pretty proud of it! was great experience. Thoughts? Image: a photo of a bowl with a colorful design on it
bowl is awesome, Mel! What gave you the idea for all colors and patterns?
Thanks, Caroline! I'm obsessed with those, I made something to catch the eye make people smile. Plus, painting helps me express feelings be creative. Each stroke carries a part of me.
